@realms: Essence
@prime_stats: Em, Ag
@description:
 Mana Molders are Pure spell users of Essence who concentrate on Mana Forms.
 Mana Forms are solid manifestations of the Essence. Mana Molders employ their
 spells to create temporary items, force fields, and even mana creatures. Mana
 creatures can either be servants capable of simple tasks or warriors capable
 of following simple orders.
